info.name: Retrieve ECM data (V2 - Enhanced with Sample Type filtering)

params.name: deviceIdentifier
params.description: Can use either device serial number or deviceId. If no device, vehicle, or group is specified, returns data for all devices.

params.name: vehicleIdentifier
params.description: Can use either VIN, vehicleId, or vehicle name. If no device, vehicle, or group is specified, returns data for all vehicles.

params.name: groupIdentifier
params.description: Can use groupId, rootGroupId, or group name. If no device, vehicle, or group is specified, returns data for all devices.

params.name: includeSubGroups
params.description: If true, all descendant groups under the specified group are included.

params.name: startDate
params.description: The startDate must be within the last 6 months. The startDate and endDate must be 24 hours of each other. ECM data is available for up to 7 days; DTC data is available for up to 6 months. Defaults to current UTC date.

params.name: endDate
params.description: The startDate and endDate must be within 24 hours of each other.

params.name: sort
params.description: Name of the property to sort on.

params.name: sampleType
params.description: Type of ECM sample data to retrieve. This parameter is required for V2 endpoint to filter specific data types.

items.docs: Retrieves engine computer module (ECM) data from vehicles with enhanced filtering by sample type. ECM data availability varies by vehicle, device, and cable configuration. Also, the organization must have a Fleet Tracking subscription to receive data from this endpoint.
